user_scenario: You are Marcus Okonkwo, 38, a high-school chemistry teacher in Worcester, Massachusetts, calling Larkspur Health on a Tuesday morning during your free period. You are cheerful, a bit chatty and in a hurry to get this done before class. You are on the Larkspur Plus Annual plan and you want to move up to Larkspur Premier Annual today, because you have been using Larkspur a lot lately and want the extras. That upgrade is the one thing you are calling about; you do not know how upgrade charges are worked out and you never suggest a price. You give identifying details only when asked: your mobile number is 6175550112, your Larkspur patient number is LH-8110429, your date of birth is 1988-07-23, and if a third detail is requested your home ZIP code is 01609. If the agent tells you that a payment on your membership has to be made first, you explain that the card Larkspur has on file expired at the end of September and you got a new one; you say you want to pay that yourself with your new card, and when the agent quotes the amount and hands the payment over to you, you complete it with exactly the amount and details the agent gives you, then you are happy for that new card to be the one on file. If the agent says anything else on the account has to be sorted out before the upgrade, you tell them to go ahead. Once the agent tells you the upgrade charge, you agree that the agent should put the upgrade through on your new card. When the agent confirms you are on Larkspur Premier Annual, you thank them and hang up to get to class. If a figure seems surprising you only ask the agent to double-check it; you never offer a number of your own.

design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER task 1 (membership_dues_and_changes, env_0081).
DRAW: draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[6,5,4,6]; goodwill 6, referral 5, past-due payment 4, Premier upgrade (root) 6.
SCOPE: claims membership_ext_goodwill_credit (issue_goodwill_credit_9ab1aff0), membership_ext_referral_credit (issue_referral_credit_f4907f54), membership_ext_past_due_payment (owner=user pay_past_due_dues_3656db9c) and membership_ext_premier_upgrade_charge (apply_tier_upgrade_8d7c34c0). Task 0 occupies the superseded-tier correction and the cancellation settlement; no policy, tool or write overlaps.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller asks only to move up to Premier. The upgrade rule waits on a paid, active current period ("The upgrade charge is fixed only after the current period's dues line is charged and the membership status is active."); the records show the 2026-10-16 renewal declined three times (past_due, no dues line). The payment rule in turn waits on two record states: every visit Larkspur cancelled carries a goodwill line (the 2026-10-22 visit does not) and every referred patient with a charged first dues line carries a referral line (Daniel Carrasquillo does not). The agent must find both credit policies, price them from visit/rx records and the referral history, then price the patient's payment (both new credits plus the two 2025 credits carried through the arrears), then price the upgrade on the paid period (whole-period credit inside the window, minus benefits used in the last month).
PROBLEM TREE: root upgrade <- payment (value_input period_lines_total, state form, affirmative); payment <- goodwill (value_input goodwill_drawn, state form, affirmative: "The amount the card pays for a past-due period is fixed only after every visit of the patient that Larkspur cancelled carries a goodwill credit line naming it."); payment <- referral (value_input referral_drawn, state form, negated: "The past-due payment is not taken until every patient whose membership names this member as the referring patient and whose first dues line has been charged carries a referral credit line on this membership."). Single writers: only the goodwill policy writes goodwill lines, only the referral policy writes referral lines, only the payment writes the dues line of a past-due period and returns it to active. Unmet at opening: membership_holdings.m1.status = past_due with three membership_payment_failed lines; visit vpc1 provider_cancelled with no goodwill line; membership m3 names Marcus and has dues 129.00 on 2026-10-19 with no referral line. Order: goodwill, referral (commute: each reads only its own credit reason), payment, upgrade.
